comparison_basis: common-origin recursive hindcast metrics at identical lead times within each station

definitions.rmse_cm: sqrt(mean((predicted-observed)^2)) after conversion from m to cm
definitions.pearson_r: Pearson product-moment correlation over finite observed/predicted pairs
definitions.top5: abs(observed) >= within-lead 95th percentile on common origins
definitions.rapid_rise: observed one-hour rise >= within-lead 90th percentile of positive rises

warnings: Raw independent-test observations are required for ACF and surge-scale analysis.
No paired bootstrap is performed without exported per-origin predictions.
Known future ERA5 reanalysis is used in rolling experiments; results are hindcasts, not operational forecasts.
